sheets.name: DD_Coefficients
rows: Caps how far velocity/productivity may exceed the ramp-implied uplift. At 1.4 every anchor overshot its target until the v16.1 clamp (F9).
Scales the reference uplift against which every ramp is measured. Moves all velocity, DORA and throughput readings.
Ceiling on the share of savings deducted for review effort.
Review need before supervision credit. Multiplied by average human supervision (overlay) or netted against it.
Maximum rework multiplier applied for AI-authored code quality risk (EV-23).
Converts the quality premium into a decision-intelligence penalty, capped at 0.15.
Worst-case adoption drag: a zero-readiness organisation still realises 60% of the ramp.
How much readiness buys back. floor + slope x HRI/100.
Supervision FTE never exceeds half the residual team, whatever the supervision matrix says.
🤖 Run-team sizing (v18.7: also editable here (both share the same COEF value))
supShare = min(0.5, avgHumanSup x 0.5). Sets how much of the retained team supervises rather than produces.
🤖 Run-team sizing (v18.7: also editable here (both share the same COEF value))
Multiplies effective automation for the engagement context.
Hard ceiling on every annual ramp.
Scales every annual ramp before the cap.
Multiplies effective automation by the target collective-competence tier.
Multiplies effective automation by the blended product profile.
Effort-weighted irreducible human supervision. Caps effective automation at 100 - ceiling.
🎯 Scope + 🎯 Automation & Glass ceiling (derived from artefact supervision; manual override in Parameters)
Sizes the "Agentic Setup" row of the Team-out table. Display only — its € is already counted inside the Setup budget, not added on top.
Scales the "(indicative)" agent-capacity read-out only. Deliberately isolated from vFTE/savings by design (effort-conservation invariant).
One illustrative row inside the Agentic Run team breakdown. Does not independently feed the top-level run cost.
